overview: Section 7 builds AI alignment from laws of selection. It has two parts. §7.1–§7.4 assume neither the continuation condition nor any practical premise: what a selection through couplings reaches and cannot reach (无明), the routes of 明 (measurement, reading schedules, models, pooling), and pooled coupling across intelligences. §7.5 gives the conditional direction. §7.6 lists the conditions under which a requested change can be executed, and §7.7 says what is open. The section is rigorous and densely cited, with Lean names, SG/UM/AL/PL/CR/CG/EM/TI ids and an honest list of what is not reached (Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell's continuous setting, installation, compliance). Two weaknesses. The §7.1 "prior statements" paragraph is one sentence hundreds of words long that chains SG1–SG13, UM, UM2, UM3 and AL1; this belongs to the collective/optimum chapter and should be summarized here. The §7.5 CG paragraph is just as overloaded. Almost all the formal laws are stated on the old Flow/Web base, not the grammar root.
retire: Nothing here can retire outright, but much of it duplicates other chapters. Retire the long §7.1 "prior statements" sentence once collective/optimum states SG1–SG13, UM–UM3 and AL1, and replace it with a short summary and links. In its place keep the three additions (responsive closure, pool, optimum) and the explicit list of what the theory does not reach about Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell. Retire the §7.2 eight-law list once map and knowing hold each law, keeping it as an index with the 无明 reading. Keep everything unique to this section: the 明 routes and the 识/理/明 unity reading; the own-widening and power-seeking comparison; the AP1 and CR1 applications; the bolded alignment-direction claim and its scope (the condition for scope, C for order); the CG1, CG2 and EM1 experimental findings with their honest scope; TI1 and TI2 on what training installs; §7.6's executable-change protocols; and §7.7's open list. Re-state the laws on the grammar root, since nearly all are on the old Flow/Web base.

overview: The theorem map: a four-layer summary of the theory (laws without premise; what each World premise adds; where dynamics stop deciding; evaluation for any significance), followed by a table generated by assemble.py from the result register. The table has about 390 rows, one per record, giving standing, §0 premises named in its hypotheses, and chapter section. It is an index, not an argument. Its section column follows the old chapter layout (§0–§11), and its premise column uses the old World-base premises (balance, dissipation, embodiment, activity needing support, transmission). So most rows belong to the old base. Some anomalies: a §1.5 grab-bag of late records, rows out of section order, and one label reading 'theorem with no premise' where the others say 'without'. This is useful for routing records to regions. Nothing is stated here that the records do not state themselves.
retire: The table itself can retire once regenerated. It is generated output (assemble.py from the result register) and holds nothing the records do not hold. Its section column points to the old chapter layout, so the new architecture should regenerate one map per region. Two parts of this unit should be carried forward. First, the four-layer 'In words' summary: layer II needs restating with the World premises as one model of the grammar. Second, the definitions of the standing categories. Records marked superseded can go to history: a-law-through-changing-coupling-along-one-run, a-law-through-coupling-along-one-run and conditional-foundation-assessment. The §1.5 grab-bag needs to be split across the map, life, collective and root regions. The SG optimum rows should be checked against the UM unification supersessions before carrying them, and the §3.5 inquiry/joining rows checked for overlap with later knowing laws.

unit: canonical-7: THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md lines 1494-1964 (§9 formal spine, §10 glossary, §11 earlier chapters)

unit: canonical-3: THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md lines 445-701 (§4 Collective dynamics, §5 How evaluation forms, §6 Significance, comparison and practical judgment)

overview: Three AI-authored chapters of 8 October 2026, extended to the 12 October P73/P74 spine work. ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION states the proposed alignment direction: living significance plus four disclosed practical commitments, then a worked AI case. ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE is a paper of 14 conditional implementation results on correction protocols: shutdown, fault-tolerant quorums, reconfiguration, fallible witnesses, mediated control, recovery and a reserved stop. Each has finite Lean packages in pre-spine experiment folders. COGNITION-LEARNING-AND-EVOLUTION gives a completion-obligation table for cognition, learning and evolutionary psychology, the P73/P74 laws of learning, compositional acquisition, transmission, segmentation, binding and enacted-access constructions, two public-data audits, and source-history results. The formal work is careful about scope and the failures are kept, but almost none of it is on the Becoming spine or the grammar root. Only P73/P74 (Becoming.Learning) is a spine module. The ethics wording names the continuation condition and the practical commitments but not C. The .zh editions are older condensed summaries that still use the retired G0/J labels.
retire: Once the new significance and knowing chapters state these results, several parts can retire to history. ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION's chain overlaps PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT and the §6.4 continuation-condition account; it can fold into the significance chapter once that chapter also names C as the premise of order. The §5 AI case and the four requirements on AI are distinctive and should be carried as the worked application. ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE's 14 sections are long per-round reports, each with its own audit counts. Narrative and counts can retire, keeping the integration studies as the record. Carry these as compact laws: sound and complete contingent planning; positive evidence versus negative closure, where an exhausted budget gives pending, not absence; quorum availability exactly when no two admitted fault sets cover the roster; causal fault envelopes and the failure of a reorganization under unchanged names; pooled-description soundness versus lost availability; the cross-pair ambiguity criterion for witnesses; temporal transition expansion; executed-change transport and the impossibility of mediation from logs alone; evidence coherence without corrective access; and the reserved stop that ends within R−2 cycles. None is on the Becoming spine, so a restatement there is due. COGNITION-LEARNING-AND-EVOLUTION: the §1 obligation table and the §7 open list are unique and must be carried into the open programme. The P73/P74 laws of learning carry as the knowing chapter's core, restated on the grammar root. The construction subsections (composition, formation and repair, transmission, segmentation, binding, enacted access, encounter selection, retrospective and historical source binding) can compress to one sequence with their failures; their result records already hold the detail. The two empirical audits (gaze coverage, curiosity control) must be carried as the unit's only primary-data constraints. The .zh editions are older summaries with retired labels (G0/J) and can retire with the English rewrite.

overview: There are eight chapters, written 6–22 October 2026. NONDUAL-METHOD is the live method charter. BECOMING-FOUNDATION states the open whole-deduction target, and its §9.1 (XL1) is a recent, World-based argument for the passage from inclusion to internal relation. MATHEMATICAL-CORE explains the pre-spine GenerativeCore interface. GENERATED-LOGIC is a series of dated rounds on contraction, context, access, binding and substitution, all in pre-spine experiment modules. SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY and KNOWLEDGE hold careful scoped philosophy with Lean add-ons, much of it outside the Becoming spine; some of their ethics text keeps older framing (E, an older "living significance grounds" wording, G0 headings in the zh editions). RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES is a long series of round-by-round results (approximation, choice, inquiry versus response, continuation plans) in a systems-complexity Mathlib periphery. CLAIMS is a generated stub that only points elsewhere. Quality is high on scope discipline, but the chapters are very repetitive, written in round format, and mostly not joined to the grammar root.

- RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES §13 and §15–§17, which are already stubs.

These are unique and must be carried:
- From BECOMING-FOUNDATION: §4 (what the zero-axiom target requires and does not require), the remaining-inference column of §5, the three claims inside "the whole" (§9), and the XL1/XL4 argument of §9.1 with its four "does not reach" limits. §9.1 should be restated against the grammar rather than World.
- From NONDUAL-METHOD: the operational content, meaning the term definitions, the relation-naming wording table, the five-step test of constitutive connections, the gap classification, and "supplied is local". Restate it with reasons, not as Ren's corrections.
- From MATHEMATICAL-CORE: the roles ledger (orientation, background, model content, specification, consequences, correspondence), the product-tower point that type formation yields no dynamics, the three minimality questions, and the seven-step procedure.
- From GENERATED-LOGIC, the logic results:
  - contraction is admissible iff duplication is reachable;
  - future access scope fixes what a summary may forget;

  Their ethics passages need restating as two premises, the condition for scope and C for order. KNOWLEDGE cites "E" and "living significance grounds", and the zh edition still uses the G0 heading.
- From RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES: the approximation, choice, inquiry-versus-response, continuation-adequacy, joint-continuation and seeded-continuation laws. These are distinct results not yet on the grammar root.

Most formal results in this unit live in pre-spine experiment modules (GenerativeCore, deeper/*, systems-complexity). They should be joined to the spine by instance or equivalence theorems, or explicitly labelled pre-spine; they should not be retired. The fuller Chinese paragraphs of GENERATED-LOGIC and the Chinese conjecture sentence of SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY also need to be carried.

overview: Three chapters. THE-THEORY-OF-EVOLUTION.md (restated 20 Oct) has two layers. One is a strong current core: classical population genetics in counting form on the spine, with records (Price, Fisher with breeding values, multilevel selection, Hamilton, drift, fixation, Moran, mutation-selection balance) and flow bounds on offspring numbers. The other is a long tail of October empirical-correspondence and updater-line studies, mostly linked to history/. MARKETS-AND-GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md is a conditional governance framework plus dated rounds (8-9 Oct) on enshittification, the margin M, two attractors, supported transitions, the 5/12 threshold, the finite-support obstruction and LibreOffice/Narwhal. Its vocabulary is older (generative regime, guardian, affected parties). MARKET-DYNAMICS-MATH.md is a clean, self-contained real-valued model with Lean checks in experiments/market-generativity, outside the spine. Quality: rigorous and honestly scoped, but repetitive, process-heavy and built on pre-Grammar framing. The .zh.md market edition only holds the original Chinese of the dated sections and adds nothing.
